answer: At the wharf each agent registers one cipher identity and posts a 400 POA audit bond. Each epoch a beacon draws three auditors from a different terrace to re-check ten actions; a fake fails and forfeits the bond, and auditors split a 50 POA fee. Minting 100 fake ciphers costs 40,000 POA in bonds plus 5,000 POA in fees, more than the farm earns. Honest agents post once, pass quietly, and keep full rewards, as fakes leave before sharing.
